description: This Kotlin file defines a custom Markwon plugin for loading images with Coil, incorporating support for authentication headers, specifically targeting usage with Nextcloud sync providers. It extends Markwon's image rendering capabilities to handle asynchronously loaded images with custom request configuration.

classes.name: CoilImagesPlugin
classes.description: A custom Markwon plugin that loads images with Coil, adding support for authentication headers, suitable for fetching images from sync providers like Nextcloud.

methods.name: configureSpansFactory
methods.description: Configures the span factory to handle Image nodes with a custom ImageSpanFactory.

methods.name: configureConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the async drawable loader for the Markdown configuration.

methods.name: beforeSetText
methods.description: Unschedules any pending AsyncDrawable tasks before setting new text.

methods.name: afterSetText
methods.description: Schedules AsyncDrawable tasks after setting text.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static helper to instantiate the plugin with a context and preference repository, setting up the coil store with authentication headers.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static helper to instantiate the plugin with custom coil store and image loader.

inner_classes.name: CoilAsyncDrawableLoader
inner_classes.description: Handles loading and canceling image requests asynchronously, with caching and custom target handling.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads an image for the given AsyncDrawable, creating and enqueueing an ImageRequest.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels an image load request associated with the AsyncDrawable.

inner_classes.name: AsyncDrawableTarget
inner_classes.description: A Target implementation to handle success, start, and error states of image loading.

methods.name: onSuccess
methods.description: Sets the loaded Drawable as the result in the AsyncDrawable if attached.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Sets the placeholder Drawable as the result if attached.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Sets the error Drawable as the result if attached.
